1.consolidated_definition: Pez que se pesca mar afuera, pez “de lo hondo”, “de lo azul”. Los pescadores dicen “peje de veril”.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fish caught at sea, a "deep-sea" or "blue-water" fish. Fishermen refer to it as "peje de veril".
